theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) customized with Industrial precision
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: A high-contrast, data-dense enterprise tool requires extreme clarity. The 'Swiss Brutalism' edge ensures it doesn't look like a generic SaaS product, while an industrial accent color (Blaze Orange) provides a subtle nod to physical inventory/warehousing.
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Objective, highly functional, rigid, crisp, authoritative.

typography.rules: Avoid Inter/Roboto. Use geometric and robust typography tailored for tabular data and numeric legibility.

headings.usage: H1-H4. Chivo's squarish proportion feels industrial and solid.

body.usage: Main UI text, labels, table data. Incredible legibility for dense data.

mono.usage: Invoices, SKUs, financial numbers, status codes.

rules.gradients: BANNED. Use flat colors and 1px crisp borders only.
rules.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders (Grid Borders style) for separation rather than soft shadows.
rules.ctas: Primary buttons use primary_accent (#EA580C). Secondary buttons are transparent with 1px border. Never use primary accent for non-interactive elements.

spacing_scale.tight_data: p-2 or p-3 (for tables and dense lists)

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-md (6px maximum). Avoid pill shapes to maintain the structured, enterprise feel.

dashboard_rules.kpi_cards: col-span-1. Flat background, 1px border. Use monospaced numbers for metrics.
dashboard_rules.data_tables: col-span-full or col-span-3. No outer shadow. Tight rows.
dashboard_rules.alignment: Numbers right-aligned. Text left-aligned. Actions right-aligned.

components.sidebar: Dark mode styling (#0F172A) on the left sidebar to anchor the layout. Uses Phosphor icons. Collapsible to icons-only for more screen real estate.
components.tables: shadcn/ui Table. Override default padding to 'py-2 px-3' for higher data density. Header text should be 'text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500'. Highlight hover row 'hover:bg-slate-50'.
components.forms: shadcn/ui Input, Select, DatePicker. Use 'h-8' or 'h-9' (compact) instead of 'h-10'. Labels are 'text-sm font-medium'. Wrap multi-line forms (like Invoices) in 1px border panels with 'bg-slate-50' header rows.
components.modals: shadcn/ui Dialog. Max-width 'md:max-w-2xl'. Include sticky footer with Primary/Secondary actions.
components.toast: Sonner. Position 'bottom-right'. Style: Flat, 1px border, left-border colored based on status (Red/Green/Orange).
components.tabs: shadcn/ui Tabs. Override 'h-9' to 'h-auto'. Use for 'Detail Screens' (e.g., Customer Details -> Info, Invoices, Payments).
components.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Weight: Regular or Bold for active states, minimal detail for dense grids).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Tables: 'bg-slate-50'. Buttons: slight darkening. Links: underline offset-2.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Dark sidebar ensures high contrast for nav items.
accessibility.aria: Include 'aria-label' for icon-only buttons (like Edit/Delete in tables).

images.description: Empty modern warehouse interior with polished concrete floor
images.placement: Use as the right-side split panel image on the login screen. Apply a 'bg-black/20' overlay or an orange-tinted multiply blend if needed for brand consistency.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Vite, install Tailwind and Shadcn UI.
Install specific fonts: Chivo (Google Fonts), IBM Plex Sans (Google Fonts), IBM Plex Mono (Google Fonts).
Setup global CSS with background colors and tight letter spacing overrides for headings.
Build standard Layout with a fixed, collapsible dark sidebar and a top header containing breadcrumbs and user profile.
Implement compact Table components. Ensure Shadcn Table cells use p-2 or p-3.
Create reusable Form modules (Input, Select, Label) using h-8 compact sizing.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and links have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
